description: Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 (admin/admin). A department manager in the Management division has resigned effective today and HR must close out her record before end of business. Four actions are required: (1) two employees currently report to her as their direct manager — reassign both to a different active manager before her access is revoked; (2) an expense report she submitted this week cannot be processed after departure — refuse it; (3) archive her employee record using the proper departure workflow, setting the departure reason and effective date; (4) as part of the offboarding checklist, post a note in her employee chatter confirming that her remaining paid-time-off balance has been reviewed. Navigate to the Employees module to identify the departing manager and complete all four closure steps.
